request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, fabric and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, bags, jars, packaging and walls. A first-time learner must understand the action instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Luis, the man who faces the camera: about thirty, short curly black hair, a dark jacket over a light-blue shirt. Keep his face, hair and clothes exactly and leave out the woman in the foreground. Create a NEW photograph in a different place: a bright home kitchen in the morning, with cupboards, a sink and a window clearly showing that it is a kitchen. Luis has taken off his jacket and wears his light-blue shirt with rolled sleeves. He STANDS at the kitchen counter and MAKES breakfast: he spreads red jam on a slice of toast with a knife, and on the counter in front of him are a plate with two more slices of toast, an open jar of red jam with no label and a bowl of whole oranges. He looks down at the toast he is preparing. Making breakfast is unmistakable. He is NOT eating or drinking: nothing is near his mouth, and there is no cup, no table and no chair in the photo. Luis is seen from the waist up in three-quarter view, sharp, with his hands and the food fully visible. Exactly one person; no stove flame, no frying pan, no eggs, no pets and no phone. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
